_about: Which model each REELIX agent uses, in order. The pipeline runs the first; if it hits a usage/rate limit or is overloaded, it re-runs the same job on the next one. Strongest -> lightest: fable, opus, sonnet, haiku. Opus and Fable use the most of your usage limit, so simple jobs use sonnet. Edit freely.

script-writer.why: Research + the script every other step builds on: the strongest model.

storyboard-artist.why: Plans every shot, the cast and the anchors: careful judgement.

set-builder.why: Writes and checks every 3D shot in code: the hardest coding job.

reviewer.why: Strict fresh-eyes review; reads many frames.

idea-scout.why: Turns live trend data into specific, true ideas.

animator.why: Fixes after review and builds 3D inserts; mostly edits files and re-renders.

visual-artist.why: Looks at pictures against the references; a good eye, not deep reasoning.

producer.why: Only the end-of-video memory job: summarise lessons into files.

sound-designer.why: Places sound effects from a short list: a simple timing job.

thumbnail-designer.why: One thumbnail prompt + the upload text.
